mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia are potentiated by chlorpromazine's SIADH effect and orthostatic hypotension, increasing risk of cardiac arrhythmias and electrolyte dyscrasia.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Na+) regularly, maintain adequate hydration, consider potassium supplementation, and monitor ECG for arrhythmias; assess orthostatic vital signs frequently.
